model.name: Quillfeather Mutual (sample)
model.documentation: A made-up insurer for trying SimpleArchitecture. Quillfeather Mutual sells home, motor and travel cover directly and through brokers. It is replacing its in-house claims system, QuillClaims, with a bought Claims platform, and its service bus with an API gateway and event streaming. Any likeness to a real company, system or vendor is accidental.

element.name: Policyholder
element.documentation: A private or small-business customer with one or more home, motor or travel policies.

element.name: Broker
element.documentation: An independent intermediary who sells Quillfeather policies to their own clients.

element.name: Claims handler
element.documentation: Handles claims from first notice to settlement.

element.name: Underwriter
element.documentation: Assesses risks that fall outside the automatic acceptance rules.

element.name: Finance controller
element.documentation: Owns the month-end close and the regulatory returns.

element.name: Insurance regulator
element.documentation: The national supervisor that receives the solvency and conduct returns.

element.name: Repair partner
element.documentation: A garage or contractor in the approved repair network.

element.name: Customer management
element.documentation: Knowing, serving and keeping our members.

element.name: Customer onboarding
element.documentation: Identifying new customers and setting up their account.

element.name: Customer service
element.documentation: Answering questions and handling complaints across phone, chat and email.

element.name: Distribution
element.documentation: Selling policies directly and through brokers.

element.name: Broker management
element.documentation: Onboarding brokers, agreeing commission and monitoring their portfolio.

element.name: Direct sales
element.documentation: Selling policies online without an intermediary.

element.name: Underwriting
element.documentation: Deciding which risks we accept and on what terms.

element.name: Risk assessment
element.documentation: Judging a risk from the questionnaire, claims history and external data.

element.name: Pricing
element.documentation: Setting premiums from rating factors and the actuarial models.

element.name: Policy management
element.documentation: Everything that happens to a policy after the sale.

element.name: Quote and bind
element.documentation: Turning a quote into a policy in force.

element.name: Policy servicing
element.documentation: Mid-term changes such as a new address, vehicle or cover.

element.name: Renewals
element.documentation: Inviting and re-pricing policies before they expire.

element.name: Claims management
element.documentation: Handling losses fairly and quickly.

element.name: First notice of loss
element.documentation: Taking the first report of a claim, online or by phone.

element.name: Claims assessment
element.documentation: Checking cover, liability and the size of the loss.

element.name: Claims settlement
element.documentation: Paying the policyholder or the repair partner.

element.name: Fraud detection
element.documentation: Spotting suspicious claims before they are paid.

element.name: Finance
element.documentation: Money in, money out and reporting on both.

element.name: Premium billing and collections
element.documentation: Collecting premiums by direct debit or card and chasing missed payments.

element.name: Financial and regulatory reporting
element.documentation: Statutory accounts and the solvency returns.

element.name: Handle a motor claim
element.documentation: From the policyholder's report to the repaired vehicle and the final payment.

element.name: Month-end close
element.documentation: Reconciling premiums, claims payments and reserves into the general ledger.

element.name: Policy administration suite
element.documentation: The bought policy platform, configured for home, motor and travel.

element.name: Policy core
element.documentation: The system of record for policies and cover.

element.name: Product configurator
element.documentation: Where product managers define cover, limits and excesses.

element.name: Rating engine
element.documentation: Calculates premiums for quotes, changes and renewals.

element.name: QuillClaims
element.documentation: The in-house claims system, built in 2004. It is replaced by the Claims platform and switched off after the last open claims are migrated.

element.name: Claims platform
element.documentation: The bought claims platform that replaces QuillClaims.

element.name: Claims intake
element.documentation: Takes new claims from the portals, the app and repair partners.

element.name: Claims workbench
element.documentation: Where claims handlers work their cases.

element.name: Claims reserving
element.documentation: Keeps the expected cost of every open claim.

element.name: Underwriting workbench
element.documentation: Underwriters review referred quotes here.

element.name: Billing and collections
element.documentation: Bills premiums and collects them.

element.name: Customer portal
element.documentation: The website where members get quotes, manage policies and follow their claims.

element.name: Quillfeather mobile app
element.documentation: The new app, live for motor claims first.

element.name: Broker portal
element.documentation: Brokers quote and bind online.

element.name: Broker extranet
element.documentation: The old extranet, kept for the last brokers who have not moved to the Broker portal.

element.name: Customer relationship management
element.documentation: One view of each member and every contact with them.

element.name: Data platform
element.documentation: Reporting, analytics and the actuarial models.

element.name: Data warehouse
element.documentation: The nightly-loaded warehouse. It stays until the lakehouse has the claims history.

element.name: Analytics lakehouse
element.documentation: Fed by events in near real time.

element.name: Reporting and dashboards
element.documentation: Management dashboards and the report packs for the regulator.

element.name: Actuarial models
element.documentation: Reserving and pricing models owned by the actuaries.

element.name: Document management
element.documentation: Policy documents, claim evidence and letters, kept for their retention period.

element.name: Correspondence and output
element.documentation: Produces policy schedules, renewal invitations and claim letters.

element.name: Payment hub
element.documentation: All money in and out, by card, direct debit and bank transfer.

element.name: Fraud check
element.documentation: Scores claims for fraud risk.

element.name: Integration layer
element.documentation: How systems talk to each other: APIs, events and, for now, the service bus.

element.name: API gateway
element.documentation: The one front door for the portals and the app.

element.name: Enterprise service bus
element.documentation: The old bus. Its flows move to the API gateway and event streaming.

element.name: Event streaming
element.documentation: Publishes business events for any system that needs them.

element.name: Customer identity
element.documentation: Accounts and sign-in for members.

element.name: General ledger
element.documentation: The books of account.

element.name: Cloud landing zone
element.documentation: Our part of the public cloud, in an EU region.

element.name: Production Kubernetes cluster
element.documentation: Runs the systems we build or host ourselves in the cloud.

element.name: Web node pool
element.documentation: Nodes for the internet-facing front ends.

element.name: Services node pool
element.documentation: Nodes for internal services and the policy suite.

element.name: Managed PostgreSQL
element.documentation: The cloud database service.

element.name: Object storage
element.documentation: Storage for the lakehouse and, soon, the document archive.

element.name: CDN and web firewall
element.documentation: In front of everything on the internet.

element.name: Head office data centre
element.documentation: The server room at head office. It shrinks as systems move to the cloud.

element.name: Virtualisation cluster
element.documentation: Hosts the on-premise servers.

element.name: QuillClaims application server
element.documentation: Goes with QuillClaims.

element.name: Integration server
element.documentation: Runs the service bus.

element.name: Extranet web server
element.documentation: Runs the Broker extranet.

element.name: On-premise database cluster
element.documentation: Databases for QuillClaims and the data warehouse.

element.name: File storage
element.documentation: Network file storage for the document archive.

element.name: Site-to-site VPN
element.documentation: Links the data centre and the cloud landing zone.

element.name: Backup service
element.documentation: Backs up the databases on premise and in the cloud.

element.name: Monitoring and alerting
element.documentation: Watches the clusters and pages the on-call engineer.

element.name: Workforce directory
element.documentation: Staff accounts and single sign-on.

element.name: Settle simple claims within 48 hours
element.documentation: The goal behind the claims replacement.

element.name: Cloud first for new systems
element.documentation: New systems run in the landing zone or as SaaS, unless there is a reason not to.

element.name: Solvency reporting
element.documentation: Quarterly and annual solvency returns to the regulator.

element.name: EU data residency
element.documentation: Customer data stays in the EU.

element.name: Claims replacement programme
element.documentation: Moves claims from QuillClaims to the Claims platform, line of business by line of business.

element.name: Integration modernisation
element.documentation: Moves the service bus flows to the API gateway and event streaming.
